./main.go:13:2: the address of cx kept where its object would have more than one owner is not supported in patina mode yet
    see docs/compat.md for what patina mode supports
./main.go:14:8: the address of cx is kept while cx is still used by name, so the object has two owners
    in Rust a variable whose address is kept is borrowed for as long as the pointer lives, and is not used by name meanwhile (RFC 0017)
    after taking its address, use cx only through the pointer; or make cx a pointer from the start, with new or &T{...}
